purpose: Independent EEG validation of BrainTriage and reduction of missed AD cases

candidates.name: OpenNeuro ds006036
candidates.reason: Provider README states same participants as ds004504 with matching participant numbers; photic-stimulation recordings do not create independent people.

candidates.name: BrainLat
candidates.reason: Independent Latin American AD/bvFTD cohort. Public directory contains 35 AD and 19 bvFTD folders. Metadata readable anonymously, file download HTTP 403: Anonymous users have only READ access permission. User reports no Synapse access. No restricted data downloaded.

candidates.name: Figshare ADSZ
candidates.decision: Downloaded for metadata audit; not primary validation
candidates.reason: Independent historical AD/healthy-control source, CC0. Archive has 12 eyes-closed AD and 12 eyes-closed control records, with open-eye counterparts. Recording-to-person mapping is insufficiently documented for a strong participant-level validation claim. No performance evaluated.

candidates.name: APAVA / Valladolid
candidates.decision: Completed independent EEG-only companion evaluation after source freeze
candidates.reason: Original publication documents 12 AD and 11 control participants with 16-channel recordings. Different endpoint and input schema from the original AD/FTD triage model; requires a separately frozen source-trained EEG-only model. Do not describe it as validation of the frozen v3 triage model.

original_model_external_validation_statu: Not completed; compatible BrainLat files require authorized Synapse download access.
external_companion_status: Completed once after source-model freeze commit 02d3e24; APAVA 23 participants; no original AD/FTD external validation claim
